# Model Context Protocol servers

> MCP 公式リファレンスサーバー群のリポジトリ。fetch・git・time（Python 実装）および everything・filesystem・sequentialthinking（TypeScript 実装）の 6 種のサーバーを収録し、Claude Code から MCP 経由で HTTP フェッチ・Git 操作・時刻変換・ファイルシステム操作・段階的思考を利用するための実装基盤を提供する。

---

## Source Modules

### scripts.release

*Source: scripts/release.py | URL: https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/blob/main/scripts/release.py*

- `GitHashParamType`
- `convert`
- `Package`
- `package_name`
- `update_version`
- `NpmPackage`
- `package_name`
- `update_version`
- `PyPiPackage`
- `package_name`
- `update_version`
- `has_changes`: Check if any files changed between current state and git hash
- `gen_version`: Generate version based on current date
- `find_changed_packages`
- `cli`
- `update_packages`
- `generate_notes`
- `generate_version`
- `generate_matrix`

### src.fetch.src.mcp_server_fetch.__init__

*Source: src/fetch/src/mcp_server_fetch/__init__.py | URL: https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/blob/main/src/fetch/src/mcp_server_fetch/__init__.py*

- `main`: MCP Fetch Server - HTTP fetching functionality for MCP

### src.fetch.src.mcp_server_fetch.server

*Source: src/fetch/src/mcp_server_fetch/server.py | URL: https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/blob/main/src/fetch/src/mcp_server_fetch/server.py*

- `extract_content_from_html`: Extract and convert HTML content to Markdown format.
- `get_robots_txt_url`: Get the robots.txt URL for a given website URL.
- `check_may_autonomously_fetch_url`: Check if the URL can be fetched by the user agent according to the robots.txt file.
- `fetch_url`: Fetch the URL and return the content in a form ready for the LLM, as well as a prefix string with status information.
- `Fetch`: Parameters for fetching a URL.
- `serve`: Run the fetch MCP server.
- `list_tools`
- `list_prompts`
- `call_tool`
- `get_prompt`
